title: Wislem
summary_html:
This article is about an NPC in Ultima VII. For an NPC in Ultima IX, see Wislem (U9).

Wislem (translating roughly to "Wise Man" in Britannian English) is a gargoyle working as one of Lord British's royal advisers in Ultima VII, and quite probably serves as a member of the Great Council.[1]
